description_en: Installs an Agent on a specified instance
description_zh: 在指定的实例上安装 Agent
kebab_example: aliyun sysom install-agent --instances instance=i-wz9b9vucz1iubsz8sjqo region=cn-hangzhou --install-type InstallAndUpgrade --agent-id 74a86327-3170-412c-8e67-da3389ec56a9 --agent-version 3.4.0-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the component to install
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the component to install
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en:
The installation type. Valid values:

InstallAndUpgrade: installs the component if it does not exist, or updates it if it exists.
OnlyInstallNotHasAgent: installs the component if it does not exist, or takes no action if it exists.
OnlyUpgradeHasAgent: takes no action if the component does not exist, or updates it if it exists.
OnlyInstallWithoutStart: installs the component only without starting the service
parameters.help_zh:
安装类型：
InstallAndUpgrade：不存在则安装，存在则更新；
OnlyInstallNotHasAgent：不存在则安装，存在则不操作；
OnlyUpgradeHasAgent：不存在则不操作，存在则更新；
OnlyInstallWithoutStart: 只安装组件，不启动服务
parameters.name: install_type

parameters.help_en: The list of instances on which to install the component
parameters.help_zh: 需要安装组件的实例列表
parameters.name: instances

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，可用于全链路诊断

code.description_en:
The status code.

If `code == Success`, the authorization is successful.
Other status codes indicate authorization failed. Check the `message` field for the detailed fault information
code.description_zh:
状态码
`code == Success` 则代表授权成功；
其它状态码代表授权失败，授权失败时查看 `message` 字段获取详细的错误信息；

task_id.description_en:
The task ID.

You can use this task ID to call the GetAgentTask operation to query the task execution status
task_id.description_zh:
任务ID。

可以凭借本任务ID调用 GetAgentTask 接口查看任务的执行情况

message.description_en:
The error message.

If `code == Success`, this field is empty.
Otherwise, this field contains the request error information
message.description_zh:
错误信息
如果 `code == Success`，则本字段为空；
否则本字段包含请求错误信息
